firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: comfort-chart tool is the hero (signature at 0%), phone in header+hero, Sample rating proof line, next band peeks ~70px; but right column is a grey box printing 'placeholder-process-gauges' (-1.0), h1 has no trade or place (-0.5), ~170px dead gap above the lead (-0.5). 390-first.jpg: h1 2 lines, both actions above fold, sticky bar.

distinctiveness.notes: Comfort Chart Dot in hero (1440-first.jpg), story dot path (1440-scroll-25.jpg), every service icon (1440-scroll-50.jpg), reviews chart (1440-scroll-75.jpg), footer badge (1440-full.jpg); differs from hvac/C 1440-first.jpg in face, palette, hero. Slop tells: decorative 01-09 numbering and middle-dot meta strings everywhere (-0.5).

type.notes: 1440-first.jpg: Chivo heavy tight h1 gives a real scale moment, Figtree body at full ink, DM Mono declared accent, en-dash ranges in prices (1440-full.jpg). 3+ tiny tracked caps labels in the first view (-0.5).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: dark story touches the dark full-bleed break (-1.0); empty story photo slots + empty break = blank run over half a screen (1440-scroll-25.jpg, -0.5); area/prices/contact same heading-left/tool-right shape (-0.5); services ledger and tan sorter are strong (+0.5).

photo.notes: Every photo slot is a grey placeholder printing its filename: placeholder-process-gauges (1440-first.jpg), drain-line/multimeter/coil-rinse (1440-scroll-25.jpg), weather-desert-sunset (1440-full.jpg, 390-full.jpg). No video despite the concept. Desert sunset is the wrong climate for Houston humidity.

copy.notes: Concrete and trade-true ('72 on the wall, 64 in the air', 'Do you come out to my street?', float switches, return-side dehumidifier); Sample labels on rating, reviews, readings, prices (1440-scroll-75.jpg, 1440-full.jpg). Primary action has 5 names: Book a check / Price it / Get a second opinion / Send my request (1440-scroll-50.jpg, -0.5); slogan section endings (-0.5).

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg composed: h1 2 lines, both actions above fold, sticky call bar; render.json no overflow at 320/390. 390-full.jpg: story stacks into ~2 screens of empty dark placeholder frames (-0.5).

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every word; chart role=img with title, aria-live status, forced-colors query, clean heading order (dist/index.html). Small mono meta on the deep band near the 4.5:1 edge (1440-scroll-75.jpg, -0.5).

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: dot travels from out-of-band ghosts into the band, motion explains the fix; split h1, slider-driven dot, compare, accordion, carousel hooks (dist/index.html). Lower sections share one fade (1440-full.jpg, -0.5); dot does not continue to the form/footer as promised.

wow.notes: 1440-first.jpg: hero dew-point tool plots the visitor's house with a 'Damp' verdict; story replays the fix on the same chart (1440-scroll-25.jpg). Output is a dot + one line, nothing to keep, and the reading is not visibly carried into the form (1440-full.jpg contact) (-0.5).

polish.notes: SVG favicon, apple-touch, OG 1200x630, HVACBusiness JSON-LD, print and forced-colors CSS, consistent square radius (dist/index.html, 1440-full.jpg). Filename strings visible in five frames (1440-first.jpg, 1440-scroll-25.jpg, -1.0).

mustFix.problem: All five image slots render as grey boxes printing their filenames (placeholder-process-gauges, -drain-line, -multimeter, -coil-rinse, -weather-desert-sunset); no real photography and no hero video
mustFix.fix: Place approved on-topic hvac frames with [[img]] (gauges on a condenser, coil/drain/meter close-ups, a humid Gulf-coast street or condensation on glass for the break, never a desert sunset). If media cannot land, remove the break band and story photo slots rather than ship filenames

mustFix.problem: Two dark bands touch and the break is an empty dark slab, reading as one 2.5-screen dark block
mustFix.fix: Give the break a real photo and set its caption strip on paper, or move the break after the services ledger so the order is deep / paper / photo

elevate.move: Make photography part of the instrument: each story photo carries its reading chip in the corner and a teal comfort-band duotone on out-of-band frames that clears to full colour when the dot enters the band, so the photo dries out as the reading improves

Recompose the hero as one instrument panel: h1 with place and trade across the top, the chart as the dominant frame with the hero photo cropped behind the comfort band, and lead/proof/actions as the panel's readout column; no separate photo column, no dead gap
